Brand identity, tone of voice & copy

Kooky Living

A new identity and promotional campaign for Kooky, a build to rent brand, with locations surrounding London and its suburbs. On behalf of Chocolate Ltd.

The work

The Challenge

Kooky provide uniquely designed rentals for people looking for the London lifestyle, without the price tag. But in a consumer search world dominated by local estate agents and Right Move, clearly communicating how different the offer truly is, was never going to be easy. THE INVENTION Be as Kooky as the product really is. Going way beyond the literal to bring a little joy to our target audience's social feeds, and enlivening Right Move listings with our stylish graphics. Not just Rent in Style, but advertising in style.
